newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LG Elec agrees on wage freeze.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LG Elec agrees on wage freeze.

text.p: LG Electronics Co Ltd, the flagship unit of South Korea's LG Group, said on Friday the management and the union agreed on wage freeze for this year.
"The union acknowledged the current economic difficulties and accepted a zero-percent wage increase," company spokesman Lee Jeong-kyu said.
He said worsening profitability helped convince union workers of the need to tighten their belts.
LG Electronics earned 64.8 billion won in net profits in 1996 on sales of 7.5 trillion won, compared with a 79.2 billion won net profit on sales of 6.6 trillion won in 1995.
The company and the union agreed on a 5.8 percent wage increase in 1996, Lee said.
